description: Generates and downloads the official 64-ray Rel-Time Sun-Stamp SVG (`GET /v1/stamp/{hash}`) for any 64-char SHA-256 hash or T_index. Requires NO API key and works across all tiers.

output_svg_path.description: Optional local file path where the `.svg` Sun-Stamp should be saved.

name: reltime_get_sun_stamp
